finalText:
Build's clean now — exit 0, 0 errors.

The screen full of warnings was almost all harmless deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc.), but buried in it were two real breaks from the bundler bump (4.2.0's options shape changed):

- `src/core/options.js:6` — the new bundler passes `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries` (undefined), so `.toFixed(0)` threw. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, and the strict boolean check threw on that. Added an `undefined` → `false` case.

I removed the two now-inaccurate comments that described these as bugs (they're fixed now) rather than leaving stale "why" notes.
